title: product/v1 frontmatter (AIP-55)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an AIP-55 PRODUCT.md — a pricing CAPABILITY attached to any referenced AIP artifact. The target is addressed by an AIP-54 ref/v1 (aip:// URI in string contexts); the target AIP needs zero pricing awareness. Price models: 'one-time', 'prepaid-pool', 'pay-per-call'. Minor units are normative. billingRail is projection config, never the source of truth.

amountMinor.description: Amount in MINOR units of the currency (cents for usd). Minor units are normative — major-unit floats are the x100 bug class.

model.description: Buy a pool of meter units up front; consumption draws the pool down. Pool STATE is host-side on every rail — the rail only initiates the top-up payment.

unitPriceMinor.description: Price per unit in minor units of the currency.

grantUnits.description: Meter units granted per purchase. Unit semantics are declared by the host, not the spec; if a wallet asset backs the pool, units MUST be minor units of that asset's `decimals` (AIP-49).

model.description: Post-paid metering: each unit consumed is billed.

unitPriceMinor.description: Price per meter unit in minor units.

meter.description: Host-declared meter id, e.g. 'agent-call', 'tokens-1k', 'sandbox-hour'. Open vocabulary; hosts SHOULD namespace host-specific meters.

productId.description: Stripe Product id — a CACHE of the last projection, never the source of truth for the price.

meterId.description: Stripe Meter id — REQUIRED when price.model is 'pay-per-call'; Stripe meters are created out-of-band and cannot be derived from the Price id.

recurrence.description: Billing recurrence for metered prices. Absent = per-unit without period.

featureId.description: Autumn feature id. Autumn natively models both metered usage and prepaid credit grants, so prepaid-pool and pay-per-call both project onto one featureId.

grantId.description: Autumn credit-grant id for prepaid-pool products, if distinct from featureId.

rail.description: Commerce shape decided, provider not chosen yet.
Vendor-specific rail. Rail-specific config lives under namespaced keys; unknown rails MUST be tolerated by hosts that only consume the price union.

kind.description: Capability kind. AIP-55 v2 is a capability; other capability kinds may exist under the capability/v1 pattern without their own AIP.

on.description: The referenced artifact this pricing attaches to (AIP-54 ref/v1). String contexts use the aip:// URI form, e.g. 'aip://42/book-companion@1.2.0'. The target AIP needs zero pricing awareness; hosts MUST refuse when the ref does not resolve.

title.description: Human-readable display name, e.g. a checkout label.

price.description: The source of truth for what is charged. billingRail is projection config; a generator derives Stripe Prices / Autumn features FROM this.

metadata.description: Vendor-specific extensions, namespaced under <vendor>. Hosts MUST tolerate unknown keys.
